messages.subject: Re: problems in wallace (v 1.0.6)
messages.body_plain:
Dimitris,

Most of those warnings or errors are safe to ignore -- they deal with models that had zero predictors or UI errors that quickly resolve themselves. In the next version, we'll try to remove them. The one that you may want to check out is the warning that 17366 grid cells have at least one raster with an NA value. That means that predictions cannot be made to these cells.
-----------------------------------------------------------
Jamie M. Kass, Ph.D.
Dept. of Biology
City College of New York, CUNY Graduate Center

messages.subject: Removing locality points in plots
messages.body_plain:
When visualizing SDM results in the GUI I've often found it desirable to remove locality points from the plot to visualize just the raster itself. After playing around with the leaflet options that are presented on the plots themselves, I can't remove the points. Is it possible to do this without exporting the raster and visualizing it externally? Or are there plans to add this functionality?

Thanks,
Connor

messages.subject: Re: Removing locality points in plots
messages.body_plain:
Connor,

Do you mean like a "hide" option for the points? That's a good idea, and it would be easy enough to add. We can see if it can get into the next version (v2). Can you please post an issue on the Github repo so we can track this enhancement? Thanks.

Jamie
